observed.unit: boardings of the current Metromover per average weekday

observed_reference.reading: the scale ratios are well below 1 because the scenarios cover internal links only (no regional inflow, no hub transfers, no visitors); the share comparison is unit-free and asks whether the allocation places trips at the stations where boardings are observed
